At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Ava nemakore gumi nemaviri, anosara muJerusarema mushure mePasika. Pazuva rechitatu, Maria naJosefa vanomuwana pakati pevadzidzisi: «Manga musingazivi here kuti ndinofanira kuva muzvinhu zvaBaba vangu?»
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Kwemakore anenge makumi matatu anogara muNazareta, achiteerera Maria naJosefa, achishanda basa rouvezi, uye achikura muuchenjeri, muhurefu nomunyasha pamberi paMwari nevanhu.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Johani anomubhabhatidza muJodhani. Denga rinozaruka, Mweya Mutsvene anoburuka senjiva, uye inzwi raBaba rinoti: «Uyu ndiye Mwanakomana wangu womwoyo, wandinofarira kwazvo.»
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Mweya anomutungamira murenje, maanotsanya mazuva makumi mana nousiku makumi mana, uye anokunda miedzo yaSatani neShoko raMwari.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Johani anomuratidza: «Tarirai Gwayana raMwari.» Andiru anounza mukoma wake Simoni, uyo Jesu anotumidza kuti Kefasi, zvinoreva kuti Petro; Firipi naNatanaeri vanomutevera.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Neshoko raAmai vake, «Itai zvose zvaachakuudzai», anoshandura mvura kuva waini, chiratidzo chake chekutanga, uye vadzidzi vake vanotanga kumutenda.
He drives the money changers from the Te: Anodzinga vachinjanisi vemari muTembere uye usiku anodzidzisa Nikodhimo kuti munhu anofanira kuberekwa patsva nemvura neMweya. «Nokuti Mwari akada nyika kudai, kuti akapa Mwanakomana wake akaberekwa ari mumwe chete.»
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Aneta masikati makuru, anokumbira mukadzi weSamaria mvura yekunwa, uye anomupa mvura yeupenyu, «tsime remvura inotubuka kusvika kuupenyu husingaperi». Vazhinji vemuguta rake vanotenda.
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Mukuru wamambo anobva kuKapenaume anomukumbira kuti auye. «Enda, mwanakomana wako mupenyu.» Panguva iyoyo chaiyo mwana anopora.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: Musinagoge anoverenga mubhuku raIsaya, «Mweya waIshe uri pamusoro pangu», uye anoti: «Nhasi rugwaro urwu rwazadziswa.» Vemumusha make vanomuendesa kumawere egomo, asi anopfuura napakati pavo oenda.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: VaFransisikani vanokudza Gomo reKusvetuka kumaodzanyemba kweguta segomo rinotaurwa muLuke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Abva kuNazareta, anogara kuKapenaume pamhenderekedzo yegungwa, uye anotanga kuparidza: «Nguva yasvika, Umambo hwaMwari hwaswedera. Tendeukai uye mutende Evhangeri.»
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: Pamhenderekedzo anodana Simoni naAndiru, Jakobho naJohani: «Nditeverei, uye ndichakuitai vabati vevanhu.» Mushure mekubata hove kunoshamisa, vanosiya zvose vomutevera.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Anodzidzisa nesimba musinagoge, anobudisa mweya wetsvina mumunhu, anomutsa vamwene vaPetro kubva mufivha, uye zuva parinovira guta rose rinoungana pamusuwo.
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Shamwari dzinoburutsa akaoma mitezo nomudenga reimba; Jesu anomuregerera zvivi uye omuraira kuti afambe. Ipapo anodana Revhi, Mateu, panzvimbo yemitero: «Nditevere.»
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Anodzidzisa Kuropafadzwa, «Vakaropafadzwa varombo pamweya, nokuti Umambo hwekudenga ndohwavo», murairo mutsva werudo, uye munamato waBaba Vedu.
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Mukuru wezana weRoma anoti: «Ishe, handina kufanira kuti mupinde mumba mangu, asi taurai shoko chete.» Chechi inodzokorora mashoko ake isati yagamuchira Chirairo Chitsvene paMisa yega yega.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Anonzwira tsitsi chirikadzi yaiviga mwanakomana wayo mumwe chete, obata hwanyanza: «Jaya, ndinoti kwauri, muka!» uye omudzorera kuna amai vake.
At a feast in Jerusalem He heals a man i: Pamutambo muJerusarema anoporesa murume akanga arwara makore makumi matatu nemasere: «Simuka, tora rukukwe rwako, ufambe.»
A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Dutu rakasimba rinozadza igwa nemvura, iye akarara. Anotsiura mhepo: «Nyarara! Mira!» uye kunova nekunyarara kukuru. «Ndiani uyu, kuti kunyange mhepo negungwa zvinomuteerera?»
On the far shore He frees a man tormente: Mhiri anoporesa murume aitambudzwa nemweya yetsvina yakawanda, inotumwa mudanga renguruve. Murume anomukumbira kuti amutevere, asi anotumwa kunoparidza zvaakaitirwa naIshe.
A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Mukadzi anopora paanobata nguo yake, uye anobata ruoko rwemwanasikana waJairo akanga afa: «Talita kumi», zvinoreva kuti: «Musikana, ndinoti kwauri, muka!»
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Nezvingwa zvishanu nehove mbiri anodyisa chaunga, achitarira kudenga, achitenda uye achimedura zvingwa, uye vanounganidza matengu gumi nemaviri akazara nezvasara.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: Pamurindo wekupedzisira weusiku anouya kwavari achifamba pamusoro pegungwa. Petro anofamba kuti asangane naye, anotanga kunyura ochema achiti: «Ishe, ndiponesei!»
In the synagogue at Capernaum He teaches: Musinagoge yeKapenaume anodzidzisa: «Ndini chingwa cheupenyu… Anodya nyama yangu nokunwa ropa rangu ane upenyu husingaperi.» Petro anopindura: «Ishe, tingaenda kuna aniko?»
A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Amai vemumwe rudzi vanomukumbira nokuda kwemwanasikana wavo: «Kunyange imbwa dzinodya mamvemve anowira patafura yavatenzi vadzo.» «Mai, kutenda kwenyu kukuru!»
He opens the ears of a deaf man, \"Ephph: Anozarura nzeve dzematsi, «Efata», zvinoreva kuti «Zaruka!», uye nezvingwa zvinomwe anodyisa zviuru zvina zvakanga zvagara naye mazuva matatu.
Pharisees and Sadducees ask for a sign f: VaFarisi neVaSadhusi vanomukumbira chiratidzo chinobva kudenga. Anovaudza kuti havazopiwi chimwe chiratidzo kunze kwechiratidzo chaJona.
He leads a blind man out of the village: Anobata bofu ruoko, oriendesa kunze kwemusha, uye oriisa maoko kaviri, kusvikira raona zvose zvakajeka.
\"Who do you say that I am?\" Peter answ: «Asi imi munoti ndini ani?» Petro anopindura: «Imi muri Kristu, Mwanakomana waMwari mupenyu.» «Iwe ndiwe Petro, uye pamusoro pedombo iri ndichavaka Chechi yangu… Ndichakupa kiyi dzeUmambo hwekudenga.»
Before Peter, James and John His face sh: Pamberi paPetro, Jakobho naJohani, chiso chake chinopenya sezuva, Mozisi naEria vanotaura naye, uye Baba vanoti: «Uyu ndiye Mwanakomana wangu womwoyo… Muteererei.»
He reproaches the towns where most of Hi: Anotsiura maguta maakaita zvishamiso zvake zvizhinji, Korazini, Bhetisaidha neKapenaume, nokuti haana kutendeuka.
Peter finds the Temple tax in the mouth: Petro anowana mutero weTembere mumuromo wehove. Ipapo Jesu anomisa mwana pakati pavo: «Kana musingashanduki mukaita sevana vadiki, hamungapindi muUmambo hwekudenga.»
He teaches in the Temple courts, \"Let a: Mumavazhe eTembere anodzidzisa: «Kana munhu ane nyota, ngaauye kwandiri anwe», anoregerera mukadzi akabatwa achiita upombwe, «Enda, uye kubvira zvino usachitadzazve», uye anozivisa: «Ndini chiedza chenyika.»
He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: Anozora ivhu pameso emunhu akaberekwa ari bofu omutuma kunoshamba mudziva reSiroami. Anodzoka achiona uye omunamata: «Ishe, ndinotenda.»
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Marita anomugamuchira, uye Maria anogara patsoka dzake achiteerera. «Maria asarudza mugove wakanaka, uye haangatorerwi iwo.»
Luke says only \"a village\"; John names: Ruka anongoti «mumusha mumwe»; Johani anotaura Bhetani semusha waMarita naMaria (John 11:1).
When a disciple asks Him to teach them t: Mumwe wevadzidzi paanomukumbira kuti avadzidzise kunamata, anovapa munamato waBaba Vedu.
Luke does not name the place; tradition: Ruka haatauri nzvimbo; tsika inozviyeuka mubako reEleona paGomo reMiorivhi. Mateu anopa munamato uyu muMharidzo yePagomo (Matthew 6:9-13).
Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Anofamba muvharanda raSoromoni munguva yechando, uye anoti: «Makwai angu anonzwa inzwi rangu… Ini naBaba tiri vamwe.»
Anodzokera kunzvimbo yaimbobhabhatidzira Johani pakutanga. Anodzidzisa kuti zvakabatanidzwa naMwari munhu ngaarege kuzviparadzanisa, uye anoropafadza vana: «Regai vana vadiki vauye kwandiri.»
\"I am the resurrection and the life.\": «Ndini kumuka noupenyu.» Jesu anochema paguva reshamwari yake, ipapo anodanidzira nenzwi guru: «Razaro, buda!» uye akafa anobuda achiri akasungwa nemachira.
As the council plots His death, He withd: Dare Guru parinoronga kumuuraya, anovanda nevadzidzi vake muguta riri pedyo nerenje rinonzi Efuremu.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Bofu Bhatimeu rinodanidzira: «Jesu, Mwanakomana waDhavhidhi, ndinzwireiwo tsitsi!» uye rinoona. Zakewo anokwira muonde kuti amuone: «Nhasi ruponeso rwasvika paimba ino.»
Six days before Passover, Mary anoints H: Kwasara mazuva matanhatu kuti Pasika isvike, Maria anozodza tsoka dzake nemafuta anonhuhwira enardo anodhura kwazvo, uye imba inozara nekunhuhwira. Anozvigamuchira sekuzodzwa kwekuvigwa kwake.
He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Anopinda muJerusarema akatasva mwana wembongoro chaunga chichiwaridza nguo nemichindwe: «Hosana kuMwanakomana waDhavhidhi! Akaropafadzwa anouya muzita raIshe!»
As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Paanoona guta, anorichemera: «Dai iwe wakaziva nhasi zvinounza rugare!»
He overturns the tables, \"My house shal: Anopidigura matafura, «Imba yangu ichanzi imba yekunamatira yemarudzi ose», uye anorumbidza chirikadzi murombo yakapa makobiri ayo maviri ekupedzisira.
Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Akagara paGomo reMiorivhi akatarisana neTembere, anotaura nezvekuparadzwa kwayo nekuuya kwake mukubwinya: «Zvamakaitira mumwe wevadiki ava vehama dzangu, makazviitira ini.»
He washes His disciples' feet, and takin: Anoshambidza tsoka dzevadzidzi vake uye, atora chingwa newaini, anoti: «Uyu muviri wangu… Mukombe uyu isungano itsva muropa rangu… Itai izvi kuti mundiyeuke»; saizvozvo anopa Chechi Yukaristiya nouprista.
He prays in anguish, His sweat like drop: Mukurwadziwa kukuru anonamata, uye ziya rake rinova semadonhwe eropa: «Baba… asi kwete sezvandinoda ini, asi sezvamunoda imi.» Judhasi anouya nechaunga omutengesa nekumutsvoda.
Bound, He is led before Annas and the hi: Asungwa, vanomuendesa kuna Anasi nokumupristi mukuru Kayafasi vomutonga nemhosva yekumhura Mwari. Muvazhe, Petro anomuramba katatu; jongwe rinorira, uye Petro anochema zvikuru.
Pilate finds no guilt in Him and sends H: Pirato haawani mhosva yekumutonga omutumira kuna Herodhi, anomuseka omudzosera. Chaunga chinokumbira Bharabhasi, uye Pirato anovabvumira.
\"Then Pilate took Jesus and had him sco: «Ipapo Pirato akatora Jesu, akamurovesa.» «Namavanga ake takaporeswa» (Isaiah 53:5).
The soldiers weave a crown of thorns, cl: Varwi vanoruka korona yeminzwa, vanomupfekedza nguo yepepuru vomuseka: «Kwaziwa, Mambo wevaJudha!» Pirato anomubudisa: «Tarirai munhu!» uye anomupa kuti arovererwe.
Carrying the cross Himself, He goes out: Akatakura muchinjikwa wake, anobuda achienda kuKarivhari. Simoni weKurene anomanikidzwa kumubatsira, uye anoudza vakadzi vanochema kuti: «Vanasikana veJerusarema, musandichemera, asi muzvichemere imi nevana venyu.»
He is crucified between two thieves. \"F: Anorovererwa pakati pematsotsi maviri. «Baba, varegererei, nokuti havazivi zvavanoita.» «Nhasi uchava neni muParadhiso.» «Mai, tarirai mwanakomana wenyu… Tarira amai vako.» «Zvapera.» Anokotamisa musoro opa mweya.
Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap H: Josefa weArimatea naNikodhimo vanoputira muviri wake mumachira erineni pamwe nezvinonhuhwira, vomuisa muguva idzva rakatemwa mudombo, mumunda pedyo nepaakarovererwa.
On the first day of the week the tomb is: Pazuva rekutanga revhiki, guva harina chinhu. Ishe akamuka anodana Maria Magdalena nezita rake omutuma kuvaApostora: «Ndaona Ishe.»
He walks unrecognized with two disciples: Vasingamuzivi, anofamba nevadzidzi vaviri ovatsanangurira Magwaro, uye vanomuziva paanomedura chingwa. «Mwoyo yedu yakanga isingapisi here mukati medu?»
He stands among the apostles behind lock: Mikova yakavharwa, anomira pakati pevaApostora ovafemera: «Gamuchirai Mweya Mutsvene. Vamunoregerera zvivi, vanoregererwa», uye mushure mevhiki Tomasi anopupura: «Ishe wangu naMwari wangu!»
At dawn by the lake He fills the apostle: Mangwanani padziva anozadza mambure avo uye ovagadzirira chisvusvuro. Anobvunza Petro katatu: «Unondida here?» uye katatu anomupa basa: «Fudza makwai angu.»
On the mountain in Galilee He sends the: Pagomo muGarirea anotuma Gumi neMumwe: «Endai naizvozvo, muite marudzi ose vadzidzi, muchivabhabhatidza muzita raBaba, neraMwanakomana, neraMweya Mutsvene… Uye tarirai, ndinemi mazuva ose kusvikira pakuguma kwenyika.»
Matthew does not name the mountain. Pilg: Mateu haatauri zita regomo. Vafambi vekunamata kazhinji vanozviyeuka paGomo reKuropafadzwa; vamwe vanofunga Tabhori kana gomo reArbel.
Forty days after Easter He blesses the a: Mazuva makumi mana mushure mePasika anoropafadza vaApostora, ovavimbisa Mweya Mutsvene, uye anotorwa kudenga vachiona; vanodzokera kuJerusarema nemufaro mukuru.
Fifty days after Easter, as the apostles: Mazuva makumi mashanu mushure mePasika, vaApostora pavaiva mumunamato nemwoyo mumwe pamwe naMaria, Amai vaJesu, Mweya Mutsvene anoburuka pamusoro pavo mumirimi yemoto. Petro anoparidza Kristu akarovererwa uye akamuka, vanhu vanenge zviuru zvitatu vanobhabhatidzwa, uye Chechi inoenda kumarudzi ose.
At the end of her earthly life the Immac: Upenyu hwavo pasi pano pahwakapera, Amai vaMwari Vasina Chivi Chekutanga, Mhandara Maria nokusingaperi, vakatorwa kuenda mukubwinya kwekudenga mweya nemuviri, sezvakaziviswa zviri pamutemo naPapa Pio XII muna 1950. Iye akabereka Ishe ndiye wekutanga kugovana mukumuka kweMwanakomana wavo.
Scripture does not record the place. It: Magwaro haatauri nzvimbo. Zvinoratidzwa paguva panopemberera Chechi yekuJerusarema kubvira kare kutorwa kwavo kudenga.
Her Son crowns the Blessed Virgin Queen: Mwanakomana wavo anogadza Mhandara yakaropafadzwa korona saMambokadzi wekudenga nenyika, Mambokadzi wevatumwa nevatsvene. «Chiratidzo chikuru chakaonekwa kudenga: mukadzi akapfeka zuva, mwedzi uri pasi petsoka dzake, uye pamusoro wake korona yenyeredzi gumi nembiri.»
This mystery takes place in heaven; it i: Chakavanzika ichi chinoitika kudenga; chinoratidzwa pano pamwe chete nekutorwa kwavo kudenga.
The Coronation of Mary: Kugadzwa korona kwaMaria saMambokadzi wekudenga nenyika
Mondays and Saturdays, and the Sundays o: Muvhuro neMugovera, Svondo reAdvent nenguva yeKisimusi
The Rosary grew out of the prayer of the: Rosari yakaberekwa mumunamato weChechi. Mamonaki aiimba mapisarema 150, uye vaKristu vaisaziva kuverenga vainamata Baba Vedu 150, gare gare Kwaziwai Maria 150, vachizviverenga patambo yemabhidhi: «Mapisarema aMaria».
By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Sekutaura kwetsika inodiwa, Mhandara Maria yakapa Rosari kuna Mutsvene Dhominiko kuProuille, kuFransi, pakutanga kwezana ramakore regumi nematatu, kuti imubatsire mukuparidza kwake achirwisa dzidziso yenhema yeVaAlbigensi. Sangano rake, Sangano reVaparidzi, rakaiparadzira muchiKristu chose, uye muzana ramakore regumi neshanu Akaropafadzwa Alano weLa Roche, MuDhominikani, akamutsiridza kuzvipira uku uye akatanga masangano ekutanga eRosari.
Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Mutsvene Papa Pio V, naiyewo MuDhominikani, akapa Rosari chimiro chayo chenguva dzose chezvakavanzika gumi neshanu, zveMufaro, zveKurwadziwa nezveKubwinya, muna 1569. Mushure mekukunda kweLepanto musi wa7 Gumiguru 1571, kwakawanikwa chiKristu chose pachainamata Rosari, akaita zuva iroro mutambo waMaria weKukunda, nhasi chiyeuchidzo cheMhandara Maria weRosari. KuLourdes nekuFatima, Mhandara pachayo yakauya nerosari uye yakakumbira kuti inamatwe zuva nezuva.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Musi wa16 Gumiguru 2002, Mutsvene Papa Johani Pauro II akawedzera zvakavanzika zvishanu zveChiedza, zvinobva muupenyu hwapachena hwaIshe wedu, mutsamba yake yeuApostora Rosarium Virginis Mariae, kuti Rosari ive «pfupiso yeEvhangeri». Muchakavanzika chimwe nechimwe tinofungisisa chiso chaKristu tichitarisa nemeso aAmai vake.
